name: IR Remote Control
fullName: 21-Key NEC Protocol Infrared Handheld Remote Controller
tagline: Wireless infrared keypad for home automation and remote robotic steering
description: A compact 21-key wireless infrared remote controller emitting 38kHz modulated light pulses encoded with the industry-standard NEC protocol. Powered by a CR2025 coin cell, it transmits unique 32-bit hex command codes for each button.

specs.encodingProtocol: NEC (32-bit: 8-bit address, 8-bit inverted address, 8-bit command, 8-bit inverted command)

pinout.name: 940nm Emitter
pinout.desc: Front-facing infrared diode transmitting modulated codes

wiringNote: Wireless standalone transmitter. Remember to remove the transparent battery insulation tab before first use.
codeSnippet:
// Codes decoded by IRremote:
// Power: 0xFFA25D | Mode: 0xFF629D | Mute: 0xFFE21D | 1: 0xFF30CF
commonMistakes: Depleted coin cell battery causing intermittent packet transmission
Blocking line-of-sight path between remote and IR receiver
